#: Greet the team — ✓
#: Sends one hello per member.
#:
#: Then reports back: 名前を確認.
async def demo(flag: bool, items: list[str]):
    """A docstring is never a caption."""
    #: Say hello
    result = await corpus.echo("start")
    #: Choose a path
    if flag:
        #: Say yes
        result = await corpus.echo("yes")
    #: Otherwise say no
    else:
        #: Pick no
        result = "no"
    if result == "a":
        result = "b"
    #: Or check c
    elif result == "c":
        result = "d"
    #: Fall back
    else:
        pass
    #: Echo twice
    both = await corpus.echo(await corpus.echo("inner"))
    #: Try the risky step
    try:
        result = await corpus.echo("try")
    #: Recover
    except ValueError:
        result = "caught"
    #: A later except is a comment
    except Exception:
        result = "other"
    #: Always clean up
    finally:
        await corpus.echo("finally")
    #: Echo each item
    for item in items:
        await corpus.echo(item)
    #: After every item
    else:
        result = "done"
    while flag:
        flag = False
    #: Loop ended
    else:
        result = "stopped"
    return [result, both]

authored.source:
#: Hoisted work
async def hoist(items: list[str]):
    #: Gather both
    pair = [await corpus.echo("a"), [await corpus.echo(item) for item in items]]
    #: Define the helper
    def helper():
        return later
    #: Set it later
    later = await corpus.echo("x")
    #: Count them
    total = len(pair)
    #: Retry once
    try:
        total = total + 1
    #: Report
    finally:
        await corpus.echo(helper())
    return total

authored.name: trivia
authored.source:
async def quiet(flag: bool):
    #: On a docstring
    """Docstrings stay discarded."""
    #: Detached by a blank line

    first = await corpus.echo("one")
    #: Done */ await wipe(); /*
    second = await corpus.echo("two")
    #: Tagged
    #: @param flag
    third = await corpus.echo("three")
      #: Wrong indentation
    fourth = await corpus.echo("four")  #: After code
    #: Far
    # an ordinary comment
    #: Near
    fifth = await corpus.echo("five")
    #: Nothing to caption
    pass
    #: Two blank lines
    #:
    #:
    #: break the rule
    seventh = await corpus.echo("seven")
    #: Fetch the eighth
    try:
        eighth = await corpus.echo("eight")
    except Exception:
        eighth = "none"
    #: No kernel arm
    else:
        eighth = "fine"
    return [first, second, third, fourth, fifth, seventh, eighth]

class Reviewer(TypedDict):
    #: Who reviewed it
    name: str

#: Not a caption: a class names no step
class Answer(TypedDict):
    """A docstring is never a caption."""
    #: What the reviewer picked
    choice: str
    #: Notes, when written
    notes: NotRequired[str]
    reviewer: Reviewer

class Item(TypedDict):
    #: The item's title
    title: str

class Outcome(TypedDict):
    #: Whether the card was escalated
    escalated: bool

#: Triage a card
async def triage(
    #: The card that was answered
    #: Sent by the review queue.
    event: Answer,
    #: Items to echo
    items: list[Item],
    flag: bool | None,
) -> Outcome:
    #: Start counting
    count = 0
    await corpus.echo(event)
    return {"escalated": flag == True}
